description: Zero-network, deterministic Markdown answers to the five EU AI Act questions enterprise buyers ask in vendor security questionnaires and DPO RFPs: Q1 Art. 50(1) notice and 2 Dec 2026 Art. 50(2) provenance, Q2 Art. 12 cryptographic event logging (keyed HMAC-SHA256 inputHash/outputHash, SHA-256 recordHash chained by prevLogHash), Q3 GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) zero-prompt minimisation and EU Frankfurt residency, Q4 Art. 14 deterministic human approval gates, Q5 audit retention, DPO evidence and Annex IV documentation. Answers match the chosen Spurvik plan: Free €0 (10,000 events/mo, 30 days), Pro €19/mo (250,000, 90 days, white-label badge, hosted approval queue, DPO engineering summary), Team €79/mo (2,000,000, 12 months, Annex IV draft, webhook export) or Done-For-You €199 once (24h install, signed DPO readiness report, 1 year of Pro). Every field is optional. Ends with links to the interactive questionnaire and signup. Review the wording against your own setup before you send it.

domain.description: Optional public hostname of the product, for example acme.eu. Prefills the report and signup links; a value that is not a public hostname is ignored and not echoed.

generatesMedia.description: The product generates synthetic images, audio or video (Art. 50(2)). Defaults to false.

hasHighRiskActions.description: Agents or tools can trigger refunds, emails, permission changes or deletions. Defaults to true.

plan.description: Spurvik plan the answers describe: free, pro (default), team or concierge (Done-For-You).

provider.description: Model provider or agent framework: openai (default), anthropic, google-genai, vercel-ai-sdk, langgraph, openai-agents, mastra, python or custom.

name: spurvik_vendor_questionnaire_answers
title: Answer an EU AI Act vendor security questionnaire
